caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet with an architectural design. The cabinet has two main sections: the upper section has two tall, arched glass doors framed by wooden borders with brass hinges, with one door partially open to the right, revealing three interior shelves. The glass doors each have four glass panels separated by wooden mullions. There is a central decorative wooden keystone at the top of the arch. The lower section consists of four rectangular wooden panel doors arranged side by side, also with brass hinges and small round metal handles, set within a rectangular base with bracket feet. The cabinet is depicted in shades of light to medium brown, accentuating the wood grain and texture. The background is an off-white color, and there are no additional objects or scenes present in the image.
title: Corner Cupboard
